item.description: MILWAUKEE, Wis. item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery: Paramount's hostile bid 'superior' to Netflix offer
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery, the sprawling entertainment company that owns major media brands like HBO and CNN, said on Thursday it now favors a bid made by Paramount to buy the company's key assets over a previous agreement with streamer Netflix.

item.title: State lawmakers continue debates Thursday in Illinois and Indiana, as tug-of-war over Bears stadium rolls on
item.description: State lawmakers continued debates Thursday in Illinois and Indiana, as the tug-of-war between Springfield and Indianapolis rolls on over the potential location of a new Chicago Bears stadium.
